full_text:
Cyclone Threat: बंगाल की खाड़ी में बढ़ा तूफान का खतरा, IMD ने आंधी-बारिश और थंडरस्टॉर्म वाले मौसम के लिए जारी किया ये अलर्ट
बंगाल की खाड़ी में 13 नवंबर को निम्न दबाव का क्षेत्र बना है, जो 15 नवंबर तक डिप्रेशन में बदल सकता है। तमिलनाडु में मछुआरों को समुद्र में जाने से रोका गया है। अंडमान-निकोबार में भारी बारिश और तेज हवाओं का अलर्ट जारी।
IMD के पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक पूर्वोत्तर भारत के कुछ राज्यों में भी आने वाले दिनों में बारिश हो सकती है। अरुणाचल प्रदेश और असम-मेघालय में 15 से 17 नवंबर के दौरान कुछ स्थानों पर हल्की से छिटपुट बारिश होने की संभावना है।
बंगाल की खाड़ी में मौसम का एक नया सिस्टम डेवलप हो रहा है। भारत मौसम विज्ञान विभाग (IMD) के मुताबिक शुक्रवार की सुबह दक्षिण-पूर्वी बंगाल की खाड़ी में निम्न दबाव का क्षेत्र बन गया है। इसके अगले दो दिनों में और मजबूत होने की संभावना है। मौसम विभाग के पूर्वानुमान के मुताबिक यह सिस्टम 14 नवंबर के आसपास Well Marked Low Pressure Area और 15 नवंबर के आसपास डिप्रेशन में बदल सकता है। वहीं PTI की एक रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक इस सिस्टम के आगे चलकर चक्रवाती तूफान में तब्दील होने की आशंका को देखते हुए तमिलनाडु के तटीय इलाकों में मछुआरों को समुद्र में नहीं जाने की हिदायत दी गई है।
मौसम विभाग ने बंगाल की खाड़ी, अंडमान सागर और दक्षिण-पश्चिमी बंगाल की खाड़ी के कई हिस्सों में तेज हवाएं चलने का अलर्ट जारी किया है। कुछ इलाकों में हवा की रफ्तार 50 से 55 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक पहुंच सकती है। झोंकों के साथ यह 60 से 65 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक रह सकती है। अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीपसमूह में 13 से 16 नवंबर के दौरान भारी बारिश और गरज-चमक के साथ तेज हवाएं चलने की संभावना है।
बंगाल की खाड़ी में कैसे बना कम दबाव का क्षेत्र?
IMD के मौसम विश्लेषण के मुताबिक मध्य अंडमान सागर और उससे सटे अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीपसमूह के ऊपर बने ऊपरी हवा के चक्रवाती परिसंचरण के प्रभाव से दक्षिण-पूर्वी बंगाल की खाड़ी में निम्न दबाव का क्षेत्र बना है। मौसम विभाग का अनुमान है कि यह सिस्टम उत्तर-पश्चिम दिशा में आगे बढ़ेगा।
तमिलनाडु में मछुआरों के समुद्र में जाने पर रोक
बंगाल की खाड़ी में बन रहे मौसम के इस सिस्टम को देखते हुए तमिलनाडु के तूतीकोरिन जिले में मत्स्य विभाग ने मछुआरों को अगले आदेश तक समुद्र में जाने से रोक दिया है। इस आदेश के बाद जिले के तटीय गांवों में मछली पकड़ने का काम ठप हो गया है। वेम्बर से लेकर पेरियाथाजई तक के तटीय इलाकों में मछुआरों की गतिविधियां रुक गई हैं। तूतीकोरिन फिशिंग हार्बर और तट के किनारे 270 से अधिक मशीनीकृत नावें, करीब 2000 पारंपरिक नावें और 5000 फाइबर नावें खड़ी हैं। इस रोक का असर जिले के 50 हजार से अधिक मछुआरों की आजीविका पर पड़ रहा है।
मत्स्य विभाग के अधिकारी लगातार हालात पर नजर रख रहे हैं ताकि यह सुनिश्चित किया जा सके कि समुद्र में गई सभी नावें सुरक्षित वापस लौट आई हैं। विभाग की ओर से गहरे समुद्र में मौजूद नावों तक भी तत्काल किनारे लौटने की चेतावनी पहुंचाई जा रही है।
मन्नार की खाड़ी और कोमोरिन क्षेत्र में तेज हवाओं का अलर्ट
IMD ने 13 और 14 नवंबर को समुद्र के कुछ हिस्सों में तेज और झोंकेदार हवाएं चलने की आशंका जताई है। मन्नार की खाड़ी और कोमोरिन क्षेत्र में भी इन दो दिनों के दौरान तेज हवाएं चल सकती हैं। मौसम विभाग के बुलेटिन के मुताबिक 13 और 14 नवंबर को अंडमान सागर में हवा की रफ्तार करीब 50 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे और झोंकों के साथ 60 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक पहुंच सकती है। दक्षिण-पूर्वी बंगाल की खाड़ी में 13 से 16 नवंबर के दौरान भी इसी तरह का मौसम रहने की संभावना है।
इसके बाद हवा की रफ्तार और बढ़ सकती है। दक्षिण-पश्चिमी बंगाल की खाड़ी में 15 से 17 नवंबर के दौरान हवा की गति 55 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे और झोंकों के साथ 65 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक पहुंचने का अनुमान है। मध्य बंगाल की खाड़ी में 16 और 17 नवंबर को भी इतनी ही रफ्तार से हवाएं चल सकती हैं।
अंडमान-निकोबार में 16 नवंबर तक भारी बारिश की चेतावनी
बंगाल की खाड़ी में बने निम्न दबाव के क्षेत्र का असर अंडमान-निकोबार द्वीपसमूह में भी दिखाई दे सकता है। IMD ने 13 से 19 नवंबर के दौरान यहां काफी व्यापक से व्यापक स्तर पर बारिश होने का अनुमान जताया है। मौसम विभाग के मुताबिक 13 से 16 नवंबर के बीच द्वीपसमूह में कुछ जगहों पर भारी बारिश हो सकती है। इसी अवधि में गरज-चमक और बिजली गिरने के साथ 30 से 40 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार से तेज हवाएं चलने की भी संभावना है। हवा के झोंकों की गति 50 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक पहुंच सकती है।
जम्मू-कश्मीर से हिमाचल तक बारिश और आंधी का पूर्वानुमान
नए निम्न दबाव क्षेत्र के अलावा उत्तर-पश्चिम भारत में पश्चिमी विक्षोभ का असर भी बना हुआ है। IMD के मुताबिक कश्मीर संभाग और आसपास के क्षेत्रों में 3.1 किलोमीटर की ऊंचाई पर चक्रवाती परिसंचरण के रूप में पश्चिमी विक्षोभ मौजूद है। इसके साथ मध्य क्षोभमंडलीय पश्चिमी हवाओं में एक ट्रफ भी सक्रिय है। मौसम विभाग ने 13 नवंबर को जम्मू-कश्मीर, लद्दाख में कई जगहों पर बारिश का अनुमान जताया है। इन क्षेत्रों में 13 और 14 नवंबर को कुछ स्थानों पर गरज-चमक, बिजली गिरने और 40 से 50 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की रफ्तार से तेज हवाएं चल सकती हैं। हवा के झोंकों की गति 60 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे तक पहुंचने की आशंका है।
मौसम संबंधी चेतावनी !

full_text:
Fragrance brand JOON has expanded its product portfolio with the introduction of LOO-LOO Drops, a perfumed toilet fragrance designed to offer an alternative to conventional bathroom fresheners. The product is intended for direct application into toilet bowls and features a fragrance blend of eucalyptus, moss, and marine notes.
Known for its solid perfumes, JOON has built its product approach around incorporating fragrance into everyday experiences. The idea behind LOO-LOO Drops emerged during one of the founders' travels, when they identified the bathroom as a space that receives little attention in the fragrance category. Despite being a frequently used part of the home, bathroom fragrance has largely remained limited to functional odour-control products.
With this launch, the brand aims to introduce a fragrance-focused approach to bathroom freshness rather than offering another product designed primarily to cover unpleasant odours. LOO-LOO Drops has been developed to make fragrance an integral part of everyday bathroom routines.
Alongside its fragrance composition, the product has been developed with an emphasis on usability and packaging. Its dropper-based dispensing system allows users to apply a measured quantity of the fragrance directly into the toilet bowl. The compact packaging is also designed to make the product convenient to carry while fitting naturally into bathroom spaces.
The formulation does not contain aerosols or parabens. According to the brand, the concentrated fragrance, controlled dispensing mechanism, and discreet packaging have been developed to make the product easy to use as part of everyday routines.
The product's name, LOO-LOO Drops, reflects JOON's approach to keeping its brand communication simple and distinctive. The founders wanted a name that would be easily recognisable and communicate the product's purpose without adopting conventional naming practices associated with the fragrance industry.
The launch also represents an extension of JOON's broader product strategy of taking fragrance beyond traditional personal perfumes. After developing products for body fragrance, the brand is now exploring applications within home and lifestyle categories, with a focus on introducing scent into everyday environments and activities.
Kanika, Co-Founder, JOON said, “JOON has always been about finding new ways to bring fragrance into the everyday. We’ve always believed in doing things differently - challenging the expected, creating in unexpected ways and, hopefully, surprising our customers along the way. With LOO-LOO Drops, we looked at a space that everyone uses, but nobody really talks about - the bathroom - and thought, why not make it smell as good as the rest of our lives? We don’t know if this is the right time for LOO-LOO, just as we didn’t know with solid perfumes. What we do know is that we’ve loved creating it, we love using it, and we’re excited to see if people love it as much as we do.”
Celima, Co-Founder, JOON added, “At JOON, we’ve always believed that fragrance can be more than a traditional perfume. It can be a format, an object, a ritual, something that changes the way you experience an everyday moment. That belief is at the heart of everything we create. With LOO-LOO Drops, we’re taking fragrance somewhere it hasn’t traditionally belonged and rethinking what a bathroom fragrance can look, feel, and smell like. We wanted the fragrance itself to be an unexpected, too—something more refined, fresh, and sophisticated than what you typically associate with the bathroom. From the concentrated formula to the discreet, beautifully designed bottle, every detail has been considered. For us, it’s another step in our journey of "redefining" fragrance - not by simply creating another fragrance product, but by questioning where fragrance belongs and how it can become part of everyday life.”
With LOO-LOO Drops, JOON is extending its presence into the home fragrance and bathroom care segment. The introduction reflects the brand's effort to explore new product formats and applications for fragrance beyond conventional perfumes, while combining scent, packaging, and functionality in an everyday consumer product.

Unbound aims to connect with consumers who prioritise movement, individuality, and new experiences, positioning its products as part of a lifestyle that extends beyond traditional grooming requirements.
Actor Sahil Anand's participation alongside the brand at the fashion event further highlights this positioning. His association reflects the brand's focus on individuals with evolving lifestyles who move across different interests, experiences and professional spaces.
Actor Sahil Anand said, “What I find interesting about Unbound is that it is not trying to be just another grooming brand. Atul Arora, Co-founder and COO, Unbound added, “We have always believed that building a strong men’s personal care brand means making it accessible to men wherever they shop and discover new products. These platforms are important growth drivers, enabling us to connect with men across markets and make our products more accessible. Our presence at Paris Fashion Week reflects the larger ambition we have for Unbound: to build an Indian-born brand with a global outlook. As we expand our reach across channels and geographies, we remain focused on creating a brand that resonates with active, modern men everywhere”.
The brand's participation at Paris Fashion Week is part of its broader strategy to increase visibility and strengthen its positioning in the men's grooming and personal care market. Organic food brand Organic Tattva has introduced a new digital advertising film, ‘Home Coming’, featuring actor and brand ambassador Kareena Kapoor Khan. Our promise of certified organic sourcing, testing for more than 250 pesticides and 100% fumigation-free products reflects that belief. Footwear brand Drifbolt is introducing 3D-printed shoes to the Indian market, using AI-assisted manufacturing technology to offer an alternative to conventional footwear production. The company's approach focuses on reducing material wastage, improving comfort, and enabling customised fits through a manufacturing process that produces shoes as a single component.
Traditional footwear manufacturing typically involves assembling multiple components, often resulting in material wastage during production. Drifbolt's 3D-printing process uses a single-part design, placing material only where required. According to the company, this method enables the production of footwear that is breathable, flexible and designed to provide greater comfort.
The technology also aims to reduce product development timelines. While conventional footwear designs can take approximately a year to move from development to production, 3D printing allows designs to be developed and printed within a much shorter period. Drifbolt follows an order-based production model, manufacturing each pair after receiving a customer order. This approach is intended to minimise unsold inventory and reduce material waste.
The company has introduced three products under its portfolio, namely Wave, Breeze and Koral. Its long-term objective is to develop mass-personalisation capabilities that allow customers to access footwear tailored to their individual foot requirements.
Kartik Khatri, Co-Founder, Drifbolt said, “Footwear has barely changed in decades. I grew up in a family that makes footwear components, and when I saw what 3D printing could do, I saw an opportunity that goes well beyond India. So we started Drifbolt. Most shoes are designed for an average foot that nobody actually has. Due to a lack of innovation, the same patterns are used in the majority of designs by brands.”
Drifbolt manufactures its footwear using an AI-assisted 3D-printing platform. Instead of conventional foam soles, its shoes feature an open-lattice structure designed to improve ventilation and compress under impact to provide cushioning. The footwear uses bio-based thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) as its primary material.
Khatri brings six years of experience across manufacturing and finance to the venture. Before establishing Drifbolt, he served as a director at Nandi Footwears and previously worked with The D. E. Shaw Group and Deloitte. He holds an MBA from IIM Rohtak and a management degree from Delhi University.
Drifbolt's 3D-printed footwear collections, including Wave, Breeze and Koral, are currently available for purchase through the company's official website.
Smart accessories and audio brand Lyne Originals has expanded its product portfolio with the introduction of five new products across its Jukebox Pro, Powerbox and Rover ranges. The latest additions include two wireless speakers, two power banks and a wireless neckband, targeting consumers seeking affordable and convenient solutions for everyday entertainment, audio and device charging.
The new lineup comprises the Leo Series (Jukebox 19 Pro) and Adventure Series (Jukebox 21 Pro) wireless speakers, Power Pack Series (Powerbox 27 Pro) and Powerzone Series (Powerbox 31 Pro) power banks, and the Squad Series (Rover 29 Pro) wireless neckband.

Through the new range, Lyne Originals aims to cater to different usage requirements with products across accessible price segments.
Kavya Vij, CEO, Lyne Originals said, "Audio and smart accessories have become an integral part of everyday life, whether it is enjoying music, staying connected or keeping devices charged while on the move. With our latest range of wireless speakers, power banks and neckbands, we aim to offer consumers products that combine useful features, convenience and affordability. Our focus continues to be on making everyday technology accessible while catering to the evolving needs and preferences of consumers."
Among the new products, the Leo Series Wireless Speaker (Jukebox 19 Pro) is priced at Rs 949. It features a 52mm dual-speaker driver with 20W sound output and offers up to six hours of playback. The portable speaker is available in Blue, Black, Red and White colour options.
The Adventure Series Wireless Speaker (Jukebox 21 Pro), priced at Rs 349, comes with Bluetooth 5.3 connectivity, 8W output, and a 52mm horn. The Powerzone Series Power Bank (Powerbox 31 Pro), priced at Rs 1,799, features a 10,000mAh battery capacity, 33W wired output and PD fast-charging technology. The five products are available through retail outlets across India. With these additions, Lyne Originals is expanding its offerings across portable audio and mobile charging categories, focusing on affordability, connectivity and features designed for everyday use.

Cosa Nostraa has been named the official merchandise partner for the film Ramayana: Part 1. It has also introduced an exclusive collection of accessories inspired by the epic's characters, symbolism and defining moments.
Contemporary accessories brand Cosa Nostraa has been named the Official Merchandise Partner for Ramayana: Part 1, bringing the symbolism, characters and stories of the epic into a contemporary accessories collection.
The association marks the brand’s entry into entertainment-led merchandise, with the new collection translating elements of the Ramayana into wearable accessories and curated gifting products.
X-FactorPro, Cosa Nostraa’s PR and marketing agency, is leading communications and media outreach for the partnership and collection launch.
“The Ramayana is an epic that has been part of our cultural consciousness for generations. Its characters, stories and values continue to hold meaning in different ways for different people. Through this collection, we wanted to translate that connection into thoughtfully designed accessories that people can incorporate into their personal style or share as meaningful gifts. Each of the three collections explores a different dimension of the epic, while staying connected to the stories that inspired them,” said Tanuj Vijay, Co-Founder, Cosa Nostraa.
Three collections inspired by the epic
Titled ‘Ramayana An Epic, Now Yours to Wear’, the collection is divided into three ranges, Maryada, Bhakti and Maya, each inspired by a central character from the epic.
Maryada draws inspiration from Shri Ram and his values and resolve, while Bhakti is centred on Hanuman ji, reflecting devotion, strength and courage. Maya explores the multifaceted persona of Ravan, including his warrior identity, devotion to Lord Shiva and association with knowledge.
The collection includes brooches, lapel pins, button covers, bracelets, bookmarks, framed keepsakes and other accessories. Designs incorporate recognisable symbols and episodes from the epic, including Shri Ram’s Dhanush, Hanuman ji’s Gada, the Ram-Hanuman Milap and Jatayu.
The Maya range also draws on Ravan’s ten faces and other elements associated with his character, creating statement pieces around his distinctive identity.
Cosa Nostraa expands into gifting
Beyond individual accessories, the brand has introduced curated gift sets across the three ranges. Available in two-, three- and five-piece combinations, the sets feature accessories and keepsakes in packaging designed around each collection.
The Maryada packaging uses white and gold, Bhakti features orange and gold, while Maya is presented in black.
The gift sets are priced at ₹2,500, ₹3,500 and ₹5,100, targeting occasions including birthdays, anniversaries, weddings and housewarmings. The combinations include products such as Dhanush brooches, Hanuman-inspired lapel pins, Dashanan brooches, bracelets, bookmarks and button covers.
The partnership reflects the growing intersection of entertainment, culture and consumer products, as brands look to translate popular intellectual properties into merchandise and lifestyle categories.
For Cosa Nostraa, the Ramayana: Part 1 association provides an opportunity to take its accessories beyond conventional fashion and gifting while building products around characters and narratives that have long-standing cultural resonance.
Lifestyle technology brand URBAN has expanded its connected devices portfolio with the introduction of two new products, the URBAN ARC Go 2 AI Smart Fitness Band and URBAN Q9i AI ANC TWS Earbuds. Whether it is keeping track of fitness goals or enjoying music during a workout, these products are designed to complement the way consumers live, move and unwind.”
The URBAN ARC Go 2 AI Smart Fitness Band is designed to monitor users' daily activity, sleep, stress, and recovery patterns through its health sensors and wellness features. Its AI-powered Recovery Function provides personalised insights into recovery patterns, while more than 110 sports modes and 30 guided meditations support fitness and relaxation routines.
Additional features include heart rate and sleep monitoring, sedentary and menstrual reminders, call and message notifications, music control, and gesture-based camera control. The fitness band comes with a lightweight design and woven fabric strap. It offers up to 45 days of battery life and IPX68 water resistance.

Delhi-based culture-driven streetwear brand HZY is focusing on concept-led fashion and youth culture to strengthen its presence in India's direct-to-consumer (D2C) apparel market. The product is part of FES's ongoing Dessert of the Month initiative, through which the brand introduces new dessert creations. Developed through multiple rounds of tastings, the festive offering brings together different textures and flavours.
The FEStively Yours range is available in boxes of four and six cookies, along with curated gift hampers. These hampers include Kunafa Pataka, the brand's classic cookies, almond biscotti, and granola. The products come in limited-edition festive packaging featuring a sticker sheet and a Happy Diwali greeting card.
Known for its 100 percent eggless, freshly baked New York-style gooey cookies, FES is using the collection to expand its festive gifting portfolio with contemporary flavours and customised packaging.
Rini Joshi, Co-founder, FES said, “Gifting has changed. It's less formal, more personal and a lot more fun. FEStively Yours is our way of making Diwali gifting feel more like FES: indulgent, playful and full of character. From the cookie to the box it comes in, every detail is there to make the gift part of the conversation,"
Priced from Rs 999 onwards, the collection caters to different gifting requirements, including presents for friends and family as well as corporate orders. FES is also offering customisable packaging for corporate gifting.
The FEStively Yours collection has been available since October 18, 2026, at FES cafés and through food delivery platforms Swiggy and Zomato.
Through this festive range, FES Cookies is tapping into the Diwali gifting market with seasonal flavours, curated assortments, and specially designed packaging.
Diageo India's The Singleton Social has associated with actor and singer Shruti Haasan for its latest festive campaign, alongside the return of its gifting partnership with lifestyle brand Nicobar. The collaboration focuses on festive gifting, hosting, and creating meaningful social experiences.
The campaign introduces three gift boxes named Celeste, Aurelia and Solenne. Haasan features in a campaign film that highlights the role of thoughtful gifting and personal connections during festive celebrations.
The Singleton Social is a platform centred on music, art, culture and social experiences. Among its initiatives is Analogue Jams, a series of music-focused gatherings aimed at bringing people together through shared experiences.
Varun Koorichh, VP Marketing, International Whiskies, Diageo India said, “Shruti brings a distinctive relationship with music and culture that resonates with what The Singleton Social stands for. We believe that some of the most meaningful experiences come from being fully present, whether that is through music, conversations, or time spent with others. Welcoming Shruti to the Singleton family is a natural extension of this thinking. As we enter the festive season, our collaboration with Nicobar brings the same philosophy into the moments of hosting and gifting, encouraging people to be more thoughtful about how they celebrate and connect.”
Shruti Haasan shared, “We live in a time where there is always something competing for our attention, and I think there is real value in being truly present. Music has always been an important part of how I experience and connect with the world, and I relate deeply to The Singleton Social’s belief in making space for these experiences. Whether it’s getting lost in a melody, sharing an unhurried conversation with family, thoughtfully choosing a gift for someone special or savouring the joy of being together, it’s these little moments that make life richer. To me, The Singleton Social X Nicobar is about immersing yourself in the single moment, being fully involved in what you love, and letting the distractions of the world gently fall away. I’m delighted to join the Singleton family and celebrate the beauty of the single moment.”
Global fashion retailer UNIQLO is bringing back its collaboration with Danish designer Cecilie Bahnsen for a second edition, unveiling a Fall/Winter 2026 collection from November 23. Built around the theme ‘Wandering Together’, the upcoming range takes inspiration from the experience of exploring the countryside during winter, with fleece-led apparel and accessories forming its central offering.
The collection brings Bahnsen's signature approach to feminine fashion into UNIQLO's functional clothing portfolio. It features relaxed silhouettes, playful design elements and winter-ready materials, creating pieces intended for everyday wear as well as seasonal occasions.
Cecilie Bahnsen said, “I'm very excited that for this second collaboration with UNIQLO we have been able to create a collection themed around fleece, which is attracting renewed attention. Fluffy, warm fleece has a certain nostalgic charm, and for me, it's a staple item essential for the season. This collection expresses femininity that women and girls of all ages can enjoy. I hope everyone will delight in the charms of the collection through layering and free styling."
Moving beyond conventional winter essentials, the collection uses fleece as the foundation for a range of apparel and accessories. Its colour selection draws from Nordic winter landscapes, featuring black, dark navy, heather grey and pale pink.
The assortment includes fleece jackets and skirts, alongside knit gloves and fleece hats. Floral embroidery, inspired by flowers growing in open fields, adds subtle detailing to the pieces. These motifs have been incorporated to complement the garments without taking away from their overall silhouettes.
The collection also introduces design elements that allow consumers to experiment with different looks. Skirts feature gathered detailing around the waist, while jackets and vests come with adjustable features that let wearers alter their length and shape.
Along with coordinated sets, the range offers individual separates that can be mixed and matched for different styling combinations.
The girls' collection brings its own set of playful designs, including peplum-frilled tops, floral cut-and-sew pieces and skorts. Notably, the skorts feature an A-line silhouette being introduced for the first time in the collaboration. The designs combine practical winter dressing with feminine detailing, offering younger consumers comfortable options for everyday activities.
Through its second partnership with Bahnsen, UNIQLO continues to bring designer-led aesthetics into its functional apparel range, with the latest collection focusing on fleece, versatile layering and winter dressing for women and girls.
Beauty and cosmetics brand Swiss Beauty has introduced its latest festive campaign, ‘We Got You’, featuring Bollywood actor Taapsee Pannu. The campaign focuses on the importance of makeup performance during festive celebrations, encouraging consumers to enjoy special occasions without worrying about their makeup.
The campaign film features Pannu dancing to the popular 1990s track ‘Saat Samundar Paar’, using the setting of a high-energy celebration to communicate the brand's message. Through the film, Swiss Beauty highlights how consumers can remain immersed in festive moments while relying on makeup products that deliver dependable performance.
The campaign also brings together two key brand propositions, ‘We Got You’ and ‘Tested by India’. While the former emphasises the brand's commitment to offering reliable makeup solutions, the latter underlines its focus on building consumer confidence through product performance and trust.
Mohit Goyal, founder of Swiss Beauty, said the brand aims to position beauty as a means of self-expression and confidence. He added that the campaign reinforces its promise of allowing consumers to celebrate freely while the brand takes care of their makeup requirements. The company will continue to focus on developing products that combine performance with individual expression.
Gresha, creative director at Swiss Beauty, explained that the campaign's central idea emerged from the observation that wedding dance floors are among the most energetic and spontaneous celebration spaces in India. The team wanted to move away from conventional beauty advertising and use a familiar cultural setting to demonstrate makeup performance.
She further highlighted that the creative execution was designed to make product performance an integral part of the campaign narrative rather than presenting it as a conventional product demonstration. The movements, expressions, and overall energy of the film were developed around the idea of testing makeup in real-life celebratory situations.
Shalini Kochar, AVP - brand marketing at Swiss Beauty, said the campaign draws on a common consumer insight that people do not want to worry about their makeup while enjoying important occasions. She added that the brand intends to establish ‘We Got You’ as a broader brand platform centred on product reliability and self-expression, with ‘Tested by India’ strengthening its consumer trust proposition.
With the festive season creating opportunities for beauty brands to connect with consumers, Swiss Beauty is using the campaign to associate product performance with everyday celebrations and personal experiences. Rather than focusing solely on getting ready for an occasion, the campaign shifts attention towards enjoying the moments that follow.
Kingfisher Strong Power Soda has introduced a new Diwali campaign centred on friendship, reunions and the tradition of returning home during the festive season. The brand film draws inspiration from Uttar Pradesh, where people working in different parts of the country travel back to their hometowns to celebrate Diwali with family and friends.
The film follows a young working professional who receives a message from his friends saying, "Aa rahe ho na? Sab aa rahe hain" (You're coming, right? Everyone else is). The message prompts him to leave work behind and begin his journey home, taking him back to familiar neighbourhoods, old friends, and memories associated with the festival.
The campaign concludes with a rooftop gathering where the protagonist reunites with his friends. The group spends time together, shares stories and revisits memories, highlighting the role of friendships and shared experiences in Diwali celebrations.
The film uses AI-generated visuals and features an original thumri-inspired soundtrack composed by Tanishq Seth in collaboration with creative agency Collective. Its musical treatment draws from the Bhojpuri folk traditions of Uttar Pradesh, connecting the campaign with the region's cultural influences and the theme of homecoming.
Vikram Bahl, Chief of United Breweries Ltd said, “Diwali is a time to come together with the people who matter most. Through this film, we wanted to celebrate the joy of reunion and the Good Times that make the festival special. It also reflects Kingfisher’s focus on building deeper consumer connections through culturally relevant storytelling inspired by hyperlocal traditions and experiences.”
Through the campaign, Kingfisher Strong Power Soda has focused on the emotional association between Diwali, returning to one's hometown and reconnecting with friends. The film builds its narrative around familiar festive experiences and regional cultural elements.

title: Cyclone likely over Bay of Bengal by November 16; IMD issues yellow alert for several Odisha districts - The Times of India

full_text:
BHUBANESWAR: The Odisha government on Friday alerted district collectors in coastal and southern parts of the state after the IMD forecast that a
cyclonic storm could develop over the Bay of Bengal by the evening of November 16.
Disaster Management Minister Suresh Pujari said the IMD had not yet shared any assessment of the possible impact of the weather system on Odisha. However, the state government had begun precautionary preparations and asked district collectors to remain alert.
"Though the IMD has not made any prediction, we have already taken precautionary measures and informed the district collectors of northern, southern and coastal regions to remain prepared and vigilant about the system brewing in the sea," Pujari said.
Sources said the minister would hold a review meeting with senior officials to discuss the developing situation and assess the possible impact of the cyclone.
In a special message to the chief secretary, the IMD said a low-pressure area had formed over the southeast Bay of Bengal. It was centred over the central Andaman Sea and adjoining Andaman and Nicobar Islands on Friday morning.
The weather system is likely to move northwestwards and intensify into a well-marked low-pressure area by November 14.
It is then expected to develop into a depression over the same region around the morning of November 15.
"Thereafter, it is likely to move north-northwestwards and intensify further into a cyclonic storm over the central Bay of Bengal around November 16 evening," the IMD said.
Meanwhile, the Meteorological Centre in Bhubaneswar issued a yellow alert for heavy rainfall in Kendrapara and Jagatsinghpur districts on November 18 and 19 in its midday bulletin.
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 30-40 kmph are also likely in Balasore, Bhadrak, Jajpur, Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, Cuttack, Keonjhar, Mayurbhanj, Gajapati, Ganjam, Puri, Khurda and Nayagarh during this period.
For November 19 and 20, the weather office has forecast heavy rainfall in Rayagada, Gajapati, Ganjam and Puri districts and issued a yellow alert for these areas.
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty surface winds are also expected in Balasore, Bhadrak, Jajpur, Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, Cuttack, Rayagada, Gajapati, Ganjam, Puri, Khurda and Nayagarh during this period.
The IMD has also warned of squally weather along and off the south Odisha coast on November 17, with wind speeds of 45-55 kmph and gusts reaching 65 kmph. The sea is likely to remain rough to very rough.
Fishermen have been advised not to venture into the sea along and off the south Odisha coast on November 17, the weather office said.
